title: 第36章 滚！老子没你这样的兵
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “那这么说，就是没证据？”“但是不排除他有嫌疑！”“我就问你，有没有证据，别我跟扯别的！”刘诚被那双杀气腾腾的眼睛，盯得有些心虚。但凡要是有证据，他都不会说怀疑两个字，而是直接气势汹汹的质问周凯东：怎么当的班长，怎么带的兵？部队里凡事得占理儿，只要你占理儿，怼排长都没事。但如果没理儿，那就是无理取闹，是故意找茬。周凯东转过头，陆阳连忙解释事情经过，却被他抬手打住。周凯东走到丁腾飞面前，直直的看着他眼睛：“丁腾飞，我问你，你有没有偷拿食堂东西？”丁腾飞摇头：“没有，我没偷。”“再问你一遍，有，还是没有？”“没有。”“大点儿声，说给他们听！”“没有！！”丁腾飞鼓足勇气，大声喊出了这两个字。周凯东满意点头，随即冷冷的看向三个炊事兵：“我的兵，说他没有偷你们东西，我信他！现在我要带他走，你们有种的就出手拦我？”这一刻，丁腾飞心底好像有什么东西，被狠狠的触动了一下。但同时，陆阳却在他的脸上，看到了非常复杂的神色。忽然，陆阳敏锐的突然察觉到了一丝不对劲。丁腾飞站姿有点儿奇怪，像是故意佝偻身子。随着陆阳将目光往下移，他瞬间明白了一切，而当他再次看向丁腾飞时，却在他眼里看到了祈求。是的，丁腾飞确实偷拿东西了，而且藏得很好，连陆阳都差点儿被骗了过去。陆阳心中叹息，尤其是看到周凯东信誓旦旦的说出“我信他”三个字时。那种复杂，矛盾，拧巴的情绪，在他心里慢慢萦绕开来。于情于理，他都不可能去当面揭穿丁腾飞。毕竟当着外人的面，需要留一丝体面。只要丁腾飞偷的不是什么特别贵重东西，其实也不会有人过分追究。因为之前他也在早饭时候，偷偷顺过食堂里的馒头和鸡蛋回来充饥，而且这么做的还不止他一个。只要不浪费，只要吃进肚，只要不是太过分，明目张胆的拿着麻袋过来装，食堂都是睁一只眼闭一只眼。所以丁腾飞的问题，就目前来看可大可小；如果只是偷拿了俩苹果橘子，回去以后班长可能连骂都懒得骂，甚至会觉得他拿少了。可偏偏就在这时，远处的炊事班副班长慌慌张张的跑了过来，手里还抱着个空的泡菜坛子。“不见了，不见了，全都不见了！”“咱们的手机，mp4，还有烟和零钱全没了！”“之前明明还在的，眨眼的工夫就被偷了！”此话一出，原本已经有些服软，准备让周凯东带人离开的炊事兵立即暴跳如雷。这泡菜坛子里头藏着他们的全部身家，现如今全部不翼而飞。再结合丁腾飞先前逃跑的怪异举动，众人立马就将目光再次对准了他。刘诚更是敏锐的发现了丁腾飞怪异的站姿，并且趁其不备一把摸向他腰间，果然抓到棱角分明的硬物。“好哇，藏在肚子里了，难怪什么都没搜出来！”“居然还会用障眼法，可真是有本事！”这番话，瞬间打脸周凯东，也让他露出怀疑和震惊的表情。丁腾飞被几个炊事兵强行搜身，却依旧在不断摇头，口口声声说自已没有偷东西。但下一秒，一个黑色塑料袋从他腰间滑落，摔在地上。袋子沉甸甸的，里头似乎装了不少东西。陆阳的心跳都漏了一拍，仿佛空气都被凝固了。他眼睁睁看着周凯东弯腰，从地上将袋子捡起来，并走到丁腾飞面前。“这是什么？”周凯东眼里带着失望，脸上压抑着怒火。他失望的是，他居然傻到相信，丁腾飞这个烂怂混混会变好？所有班长都劝他放弃，让他把精力放在陆阳和孔垄身上，他却执意想要把这个孬货带出人样来。他当着外人的面，选择相信丁腾飞，选择去赌上自已身为军人的荣誉恶化正直，最后却硬生生被摆了一道。周凯东觉得恶心，想吐，他甚至觉得应该直接把丁腾飞丢进垃圾桶，而不是让他继续在部队里祸害人！“班长......”“别叫我班长！”丁腾飞慌了神，但周凯东刀了他的心都有了。“告诉我，这是什么？！”“这是不是食堂里拿的？”“我他妈问你话呢，是不是你从食堂偷的！你耳朵聋了？”周凯东怒火，让这几个炊事班老兵不敢造次。但刘诚却很是不爽的和旁边同伴，低声嘀咕抱怨。“看到没有，我就说这小子手脚不干净，我都盯他一下午了！”“连长之前怎么说他来着，狗改不了吃屎，这回人赃并获了吧？”陆阳恶狠狠的盯着这个上等兵，恨不能把他嘴巴给堵上。丁腾飞则羞愧的站在墙角，被一道道戏谑和审视的目光注视着。在经过一番激烈的思想斗争后，他最终捏着拳头，还是选择了承认错误。“东西是我偷的，一人做事一人当。班长，我......”“去你妈的！”“老子没有你这样的兵！”周凯东瞬间暴怒，将手里的黑色塑料袋狠狠砸向丁腾飞。塑料袋并不结实，砸在丁腾飞胸膛瞬间破裂开来，白色粉末四处飞溅，像极了爆炸后产生的破片。两盒皱巴巴的临期牛奶掉落在地上，丁腾飞大半身体都被染成白色，像是被爆炸的冲击波迎头痛击。他站在原地没动，也没躲开，两行滚烫的泪水却止不住夺眶而出。顷刻间，他那傲娇又脆弱敏感的自尊心，也被打的千疮百孔。丁腾飞哭了，这是陆阳第一次看到他哭。哭的很委屈，哭的像个孩子。陆阳觉着这些米褐色的粉末似曾相识，便用手指蘸取落在胳膊上的那点送进嘴里。咸咸的，香香的，好像还带着一股炒熟芝麻和花生的颗粒感。这是......炒面？
content_en: "So, there is no evidence?" "But we can't rule out that he is a suspect!" "I'm just asking you, do you have any evidence? Don't let me talk about anything else!" Liu Cheng felt a little guilty after being stared at by those murderous eyes.If there was evidence, he would not say doubt, but would directly and aggressively question Zhou Kaidong: How did he become the squad leader and how did he lead the troops?Everything in the army must be reasonable. As long as you are reasonable, you will be fine even if you argue with the platoon leader.But if you ignore it, it is unreasonable and deliberately looking for trouble.Zhou Kaidong turned his head, and Lu Yang quickly explained what happened, but he raised his hand to stop him.Zhou Kaidong walked up to Ding Tengfei and looked him straight in the eyes: "Ding Tengfei, let me ask you, did you steal anything from the canteen?" Ding Tengfei shook his head: "No, I didn't steal anything." "Ask you again, yes or no?" "No." "Speak louder and tell them!" "No!!" Ding Tengfei summoned the courage to shout these two words loudly.Zhou Kaidong nodded with satisfaction, and then looked at the three cooking soldiers coldly: "My soldier said he didn't steal anything from you, and I believe him! Now that I want to take him away, do you want to stop me if you have the guts?" At this moment, something in Ding Tengfei's heart seemed to be severely touched.But at the same time, Lu Yang saw a very complicated expression on his face.Suddenly, Lu Yang suddenly noticed something was wrong.Ding Tengfei's stance was a bit strange, as if he was stooped on purpose.As Lu Yang moved his gaze downwards, he understood everything instantly, and when he looked at Ding Tengfei again, he saw prayer in his eyes.Yes, Ding Tengfei did steal something, and he hid it so well that even Lu Yang was almost deceived.Lu Yang sighed in his heart, especially when he saw Zhou Kaidong swearing "I believe in him".That kind of complex, contradictory, and twisting emotions slowly lingered in his heart.Due to emotion and reason, it was impossible for him to expose Ding Tengfei to his face.After all, in front of outsiders, you need to leave a trace of decency.As long as what Ding Tengfei stole wasn't anything particularly valuable, no one would pursue it excessively.Because he had also sneaked in the steamed buns and eggs in the cafeteria during breakfast to satisfy his hunger, and he was not the only one to do this.As long as there is no waste, as long as the food is eaten, as long as it is not excessive and blatantly packed in sacks, the cafeteria will turn a blind eye.Therefore, Ding Tengfei's problem can be either big or small at present; if he only stole two apples and oranges, the squad leader might not even bother to scold him when he gets back, and might even think that he took less.But just at this moment, the deputy squad leader of the cooking team from a distance ran over in a panic, holding an empty kimchi jar in his hand."Gone, gone, all gone!" "Our mobile phones, MP4s, cigarettes and change are all gone!" "It was still there before, but it was stolen in the blink of an eye!" As soon as these words came out, the cook who was already a little resigned and was about to let Zhou Kaidong lead people away immediately became furious.All their wealth was hidden in this kimchi jar, and now it's all gone.Combined with Ding Tengfei's weird behavior of escaping before, everyone immediately turned their attention to him again.Liu Cheng was even more keenly aware of Ding Tengfei's weird stance, and took advantage of his unpreparedness to touch his waist, and sure enough he caught something sharp and hard."Okay, it's hidden in the stomach. No wonder nothing was found!" "You can actually use deception, you are really capable!" These words instantly slapped Zhou Kaidong in the face, making him look suspicious and shocked.Ding Tengfei was forcibly searched by several cooking soldiers, but he still shook his head and kept saying that he had not stolen anything.But the next second, a black plastic bag slipped from his waist and fell to the ground.The bag was heavy and seemed to contain a lot of things.Lu Yang's heartbeat skipped a beat, as if the air was frozen.He watched helplessly as Zhou Kaidong bent down, picked up the bag from the ground, and walked to Ding Tengfei."What is this?" Zhou Kaidong had disappointment in his eyes and suppressed anger on his face.What disappoints him is that he is stupid enough to believe that Ding Tengfei, a coward, will change for the better?All the squad leaders advised him to give up and let him focus on Lu Yang and Kong Long, but he insisted on bringing out this coward into a human being.In front of outsiders, he chose to trust Ding Tengfei, and chose to risk his honor as a soldier to deteriorate his integrity, but in the end he was forcibly set aside.Zhou Kaidong felt sick and wanted to vomit. He even felt that he should throw Ding Tengfei into the trash can instead of letting him continue to harm people in the army!"Squad leader..." "Don't call me squad leader!" Ding Tengfei panicked, but Zhou Kaidong cut him off."Tell me, what is this?!" "Did you get this from the canteen?" "I'm asking you, did you steal it from the canteen? Are you deaf?" Zhou Kaidong was so angry that these veterans of the cooking class did not dare to make mistakes.But Liu Cheng was very unhappy and complained softly to his companions."Did you see it? I said this kid's hands and feet are dirty. I've been staring at him all afternoon!" "What did the company commander say about him before? A dog can't change its habit of eating shit. This time, the man gets the stolen goods, right?" Lu Yang stared at the superior soldier fiercely, wishing he could shut his mouth.Ding Tengfei stood in the corner in shame, being looked at with mocking and scrutinizing eyes.After a fierce ideological struggle, he finally clenched his fists and chose to admit his mistake."I stole the things, and everyone is responsible for the work. Squad leader, I..." "Fuck you!" "I don't have soldiers like you!" Zhou Kaidong became furious in an instant and slammed the black plastic bag in his hand at Ding Tengfei.The plastic bag was not strong, and it broke instantly when it hit Ding Tengfei's chest. White powder flew everywhere, much like the fragments produced after an explosion.Two crumpled boxes of expired milk fell to the ground. Most of Ding Tengfei's body was dyed white, as if he had been hit head-on by the shock wave of an explosion.He stood there without moving or moving away, but two lines of hot tears couldn't stop flowing from his eyes.In an instant, his arrogant yet fragile and sensitive self-esteem was also riddled with holes.Ding Tengfei cried. This was the first time Lu Yang saw him cry.I cried very wrongedly, crying like a child.Lu Yang felt that these beige-brown powders seemed familiar, so he dipped his fingers into the bit that fell on his arm and put it into his mouth.Salty and fragrant, it seems to have a grainy texture from roasted sesame seeds and peanuts.This is... fried noodles?
